hypothesis: Replace price-label caps with a common finite-horizon investment calculation. Maturity and care/feed costs plus shared cash, labor and placeable-land budgets prevent investments that cannot be supported or monetized; existing assets continue receiving care.
scope: Economic plan and necessary investment/plant-admission interfaces only. Frozen execution contracts, supply batching and procurement confirmation unchanged.
micro_requirements: Same visible count but different maturity produces different dated product supply, verified against official daily refresh controls.
Increasing wheat cost can veto otherwise identical new animal investment; high existing product price alone does not force purchase.
New purchases respect joint budget after expert switch; existing assets are not removed to meet a cap.
No new investment when current action capacity is exhausted; before hire cutoff affordable planned labor may be admitted only through an executable hire interface.
Assets whose first collectible output falls after final return/sell window are excluded from that output revenue.
All emitted quantities are Python positive integers <=100; any other parsing is explicitly outside local fast-engine parity contract.
no_qualification_claim: This is a pre-screen and representation diagnostic, not G1/G2 or gold. Freeze candidate and all dependency SHAs before any fresh block result is opened.

development_promotion_rule.complete: All 36 planned cases must be completed and retained, 719 calls, zero candidate errors, official/fast per-state parity with frozen v3. A parity error stops and preserves evidence.
development_promotion_rule.pairwise: Against BOTH R0 and R6, each opponent separately must have >=4/6 positive margin deltas, positive median delta, and no negative seat mean delta. PASS margin is own cash minus PASS cash; V120 margin includes both strategy responses.
development_promotion_rule.mechanism: All frozen micro controls must pass independently. The primary delay metric must pass its predeclared threshold with complete purchase/placement/loss reconciliation; otherwise this representation remains unqualified even if cash rises. Full G1 and later fresh G2 remain required.
development_promotion_rule.no_outcome_cherrypicking: All profiles, opponents and seats retained. Cash improvement without actual G1 closure cannot advance to gold qualification.

seed_exposure_policy: Do not run baseline/reference cases before R7 source and development manifest freeze.

primary_mechanism.name: Restricted purchase-to-placement waiting time including failure-to-place penalty
primary_mechanism.purchase_denominator: Every successful official BUY_ANIMAL unit, including never placed and lost units. Initial stock is excluded and reported separately.
primary_mechanism.per_lot_delay: Official placement decision step minus successful purchase decision step. If not placed by final state, 719 minus purchase decision step, including animals lost before placement. Decision steps are 0..718.
primary_mechanism.identity_convention: Global per-species FIFO for fungible purchased units. Quantity loss removes an available FIFO lot and marks it lost; that lot must not later be assigned to a placement. This is an accounting convention, not a biological ID. Frozen traces do not identify individual animals through every PICKUP; per-lot FIFO is not physical attribution.
primary_mechanism.statistic: D=sum(per_lot_delay)/sum(successful BUY_ANIMAL units) over all planned games in the compared block. Also report raw sum, N, per-game, per-seat and per-species values.
primary_mechanism.threshold: For each opponent separately, 1-D_R7/D_R6 >=0.20 pooled across both seats; neither seat mean D may increase. Zero denominator or zero parent D is PENDING, never an automatic improvement.
primary_mechanism.reconciliation: N purchased = placed purchase lots + terminal unplaced surviving purchase lots + lost-before-placement lots. Match successful official purchase/placement flows and final animal stock. Report unmatched initial-stock attribution or missing evidence as PENDING.
required_companions: Total wait integral and mean; never placed and lost counts retained
Actual purchase cost, purchased species, placement count, terminal unplaced quantity
Observed first product harvest per placed identity when supported, separate from predicted first yield
Whole-game cash and two-sided competitive margin; all paired promotion guards apply
Plant first-water, drought loss, escapes, invalid actions, terminal realization, and any uncertainty
primary_mechanism.causal_boundary: A lower mean with fewer or different animals does not by itself establish logistics causality. Disclose composition/count changes and require unchanged-engine comparisons plus cash guards. A later same-source budget ablation is required for causal mechanism qualification.
primary_mechanism.physical_inventory_boundary: A lost-before-placement lot remains penalized to step719 for the primary measure. This is an investment waiting penalty, not the physical surviving in-transit inventory integral. Report that physical integral separately.

clock_contract: The final decision is step 718 (day29 hour22); no step719 agent action. A purchase at a step occurs after that step unit actions. R7 projected cash must reserve harvest, return and sale before the final decision; theoretical field production is not automatically cash.
